deployments_detail.use: 50+ AI pilot programs launched 2025 across sales, marketing, operations, supply chain, finance, HR (disclosed in annual report/10-K)

Spectro Scientific MicroLab on-site oil analyzer embeds an AI 'Expert System' (built from 20+ years of knowledge and 10,000+ software scripts) that translates raw oil-analysis data into actionable, equipment-specific maintenance recommendations for fleets. [AMETEK Spectro Scientific (in-house)]

TruVu 360 Fluid IQ, an AI-powered upgrade to the TruVu 360 Cloud oil-analysis platform, provides AI-enhanced predictive guidance that forecasts remaining oil life, recommends sampling/oil-change timing, and flags over/under-sampling using statistical (Monte Carlo / ASTM D7720) methods. [AMETEK Spectro Scientific]

Abaco Systems SBC3901 rugged 3U VPX single-board computer for AI edge computing, built on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (2048 CUDA cores, 64 Tensor cores, dual NVDLA v2 deep-learning accelerators) delivering up to 248 TOPS for real-time deep-learning inference and sensor fusion in defense/aerospace. [AMETEK Abaco Systems / NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin]

Abaco Systems HPC2812 high-performance embedded computing system handles large data volumes and deep-learning acceleration to support AI capabilities including image recognition, signal analysis, and autonomous decision-making for mission-critical embedded/edge deployments. [AMETEK Abaco Systems]

Creaform (AMETEK) partnered with software developer Hyperganic to use AI-optimized generative-design software together with Creaform 3D scanning to design and 3D-print custom-fit helmets optimized for protection and aerodynamics. [AMETEK Creaform + Hyperganic]

AMETEK is hiring a Director of Artificial Intelligence to lead deployment of AI-enabled workflow automation and process redesign across operations and SG&A to reduce cycle time, scrap, rework, and inventory, and to embed AI into customer-facing workflows and digital service offerings. [AMETEK (internal)]

AMETEK is running internal AI-automation projects to implement AI best practices across the company, with job requirements citing familiarity with AI tools/platforms such as Microsoft Copilot for research, data analysis, and process mapping. [Microsoft Copilot (referenced)]

Crank Software (AMETEK) Storyboard embedded-GUI development tooling is positioned to build sophisticated user experiences that enable AI, helping customers bring AI-powered embedded applications to market faster with customizable interfaces. [AMETEK Crank Software]
